hints.tr: `class SafeUnpickler(pickle.Unpickler)` içinde `def find_class(self, module, name)`; izinliyse `return super().find_class(module, name)`.
hints.en: In `class SafeUnpickler(pickle.Unpickler)`, `def find_class(self, module, name)`; if allowed, `return super().find_class(module, name)`.
If not allowed, `raise pickle.UnpicklingError(f"blocked: {module}.{name}")`; `load_safely` catches it and returns `str(error)`.
